description: Does a candidate distinction (eligibility tracking, variant E; no dependency records, variant H) survive a changed boundary, scale or temporal window?
question: Is the E/C and H/C distinction detected under every boundary, scale and window tested, or only under some?
manipulated: boundary between clusters (closed at 25 % of the run)
measured: status per resolution per condition; the summary lists, for each comparison, the conditions where it is detected (configuration-sensitive) or detected in all (survives)
does_not_show: Survival across these settings is not survival across all settings; failure to detect is not absence (check EQUIVALENT vs UNRESOLVED).
